title: Tether posts $1.5 billion operating profit in Q2 as reserve buffer falls by half
summary: The world’s largest stablecoin issuer added 14 metric tons of gold and about 1,800 bitcoin to its reserves during the second quarter.

title: Coldcard's $38 million (so far) exploit shakes faith in self-custody, may push investors to ETFs
summary: A software bug in popular hardware wallet Coldcard that led to the theft to this point of nearly 600 bitcoin worth roughly $38 million is prompting questions about security and whether managing private keys has become too risky for everyday investors.

title: Quantum computing nears commercial breakthrough, IBM CEO says
summary: Arvind Krishna said quantum computing will begin generating meaningful revenue before the decade ends as investment in the sector accelerates, in an interview on CNBC.

title: Crypto faces 3 barriers to next bull run, STS Digital CEO says
summary: Institutional options selling, AI and delayed U.S. crypto regulation are weighing on bitcoin, according to STS Digital CEO Maxime Seiler.
